sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Sandbach sit top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, though their form has been mixed lately with one loss in their last five. Alsager are bottom of the division with just 4 points and have won only once all season, making this a fixture where Sandbach will be expected to return to winning ways.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a trip to Dawley Town on Saturday, with Stafford looking to close the two-point gap on leaders Sandbach despite their own recent loss. AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a mid-table clash between two sides with contrasting form—Bridgnorth have recently suffered back-to-back defeats while Eccleshall have won their last match. Wolverhampton Casuals travel to face Wednesfield Community in a local derby on Saturday before a midweek fixture against Brereton Social on Wednesday 7 October. Bilston Town welcome Foley Meir, with Bilston showing strong form (three consecutive wins) against a Foley Meir side struggling at 11 points. Shawbury United, winless in their last six games, host improving Barnton, while struggling Crewe face New Mills at home. Market Drayton Town travel to face high-flying Bilston, and Cheadle Heath Nomads visit struggling Telford Town in a fixture between two of the division's lowest-scoring sides. Brereton Social (bottom half, recent losses) host Widnes Town (bottom of the league with 2 points) on Saturday before their midweek trip to Wednesfield Community.
